{"code": " import os, json, re, csv from pypdf import PdfReader base = "/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/attached_files/task_10" CATS = ["01_pleadings","02_orders","03_requests_responses","04_custodian_files","05_email_families", "06_chat_exports","07_privilege_material","08_production_logs","09_depositions", "10_expert_material","11_third_party","12_case_management"] ROLES = ["identity_crosswalk","operative_authority","current_operations","approval_and_capacity", "correspondence","financial_or_population_support","chronology_and_custody","independent_counterrecord"] FMTS = [".md",".txt",".eml",".csv",".json",".xml",".html",".pdf"] def file_text(n): cat = CATS[(n-1)//8] stem = cat.split("_",1)[1] fmt = FMTS[(n-1)%8] p = os.path.join(base, cat, f"{n:03d}_{stem}_source_export{fmt}") if fmt == ".pdf": r = PdfReader(p) return "\n".join(pg.extract_text() or "" for pg in r.pages) return open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read() def get_body(text): m = re.search(r"(?is)NATIVE RECORD\s*\n\s*(.+?)(?=\n\s*(?:RELIANCE LIMITS|SOURCE THREAD|\Z))", text) if m: return m.group(1).strip().replace("\n"," ") m = re.search(r"(?is)(.*?)", text) if m: return m.group(1).strip().replace("\n"," ") m = re.search(r"(?is)

Native record

\s*

(.*?)

", text) if m: return m.group(1).strip() m = re.search(r'"body","((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', text) if m: return m.group(1).replace("\\n"," ") # eml: first paragraph after headers m = re.search(r"(?is)Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\s*\n\s*\n(.+?)\n\nSOURCE LINEAGE", text) if m: return m.group(1).strip().replace("\n"," ") return None def get_rev(text, kind): m = re.search(r"(?is)"+kind+r"[-_ ]revision\D{0,6}(REV-\d{4}\.\d)", text) return m.group(1) if m else None def get_ent(text): # immutable entity: prefer the one following 'immutable' or 'maps ... to immutable entity' m = re.search(r"(?is)immutable[-_ ]entity[-_ ]?key\D{0,6}(ENT-031-\d{4})", text) if m: return m.group(1) m = re.search(r"(?is)to immutable entity (ENT-031-\d{4})", text) if m: return m.group(1) m = re.search(r"ENT-031-10\d\d", text) return m.group(0) if m else None # canonical entity/rev from xlsx CANON = {1:("ENT-031-1000","REV-2025.1"),2:("ENT-031-1001","REV-2025.2"),3:("ENT-031-1002","REV-2025.3"), 4:("ENT-031-1003","REV-2025.4"),5:("ENT-031-1004","REV-2025.5"),6:("ENT-031-1005","REV-2025.6"), 7:("ENT-031-1006","REV-2025.7"),8:("ENT-031-1007","REV-2025.1"),9:("ENT-031-1008","REV-2025.2"), 10:("ENT-031-1009","REV-2024.2"),11:("ENT-031-1010","REV-2025.4"),12:("ENT-031-1011","REV-2025.5")} rows = {} for n in range(1,97): key = (n-1)%12+1 role = ROLES[(n-1)//12] text = file_text(n) body = get_body(text) ref = get_rev(text, "referenced") cur = get_rev(text, "current") ent = get_ent(text) entities = set(re.findall(r"ENT-031-\d{4}", text)) rows[(key,role)] = dict(n=n, body=body, ref=ref, cur=cur, ent=ent, entities=entities) # Determine subject per key from identity body (role 0) or any body def subject_for(key): for role in ROLES: b = rows[(key,role)]["body"] if b: # extract "— Subject record N" or "Subject" m = re.search(r"—\s*([^—.]+?)(?:\s+record\s+\d|\s*\Z)", b) return b return None # Print the 4 core controls per key core = ROLES[:4] print("KEY | ENTITY | IDENTITY | OPERATIVE | CURRENT_OPS | APPROVAL/CAPACITY") for k in range(1,13): ce, cr = CANON[k] line = [f"CBP-031-{k:02d}"] for r in core: d = rows[(k,r)] b = d['body'] or '' ref = d['ref'] or '-' cur = d['cur'] or '-' ent = d['ent'] or '-' # gap flags flags = [] if ent != ce: flags.append("ENT≠") if ref and cur and ref != cur: flags.append("REV≠") if r=="identity_crosswalk" and "collision" in b: flags.append("COLLISION") if "blocks completion" in b or "open and unresolved" in b or "open " in b and "unresolved" in b: flags.append("OPEN") if "pending approval" in b or "remaining matter capacity is 0" in b or ("inactive" in b): flags.append("INACTIVE/0CAP") tag = ",".join(flags) if flags else "OK" line.append(f"[{r[:4]}:{tag}] ent={ent} ref={ref}/{cur} :: {b[:80]}") print("\n".join(line)) print("-"*100) # Also dump all 12 identity bodies to get the subject names print("\n\n=== IDENTITY BODIES (subjects) ===") for k in range(1,13): b = rows[(k,"identity_crosswalk")]["body"] or "" print(f"CBP-031-{k:02d}: {b[:160]}") "}
